title: Agent router decision v1
description: V3_ARCHITECTURE.md §2/§3: the router's ONLY output, over question text alone. `lane` is a ROUTER OUTCOME, never a cache key. `intent` is a §4.2a CACHE KEY (owned by cloud/shared/src/intents.ts), never a router outcome — the two are deliberately separate fields so neither can be conflated with the other in code that reads this shape. `intent` is present if and only if `lane` is `cache_hit`; a renamed intent string here that drifts from §4.2a's frozen list is a silent permanent cache miss, not a schema violation, which is exactly why `intent`'s enum below must be kept byte-identical to `cloud/shared/src/intents.ts` INTENTS by hand — there is no codegen link between them.

lane.description: The router's outcome for this turn. Not a cache key — see `intent`.

intent.description: §4.2a frozen cache key. Present only when lane = cache_hit. Must stay byte-identical to cloud/shared/src/intents.ts's INTENTS.
